name: Symphony of Blades

abilities.name: Singing Blade
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals high physical damage.

abilities.name: Dissonant Blow
abilities.description: A charged heavy attack that deals very high physical damage. Block this as the tank or dodge this if you are not.

abilities.name: Blade Dance
abilities.description: The boss spins around, dealing very high physical damage around him as indicated by a red circle. The tank should stand still and absorb it if possible, while the rest of the group avoids it.

abilities.name: Curse Expiry
abilities.description: The boss stabs the ground and an AoE appears around a random target. The target will take moderate magic damage and get stunned in a few moments. This is unavoidable and should be healed through.

abilities.name: Decrepify
abilities.description: The boss stabs the ground. After a few seconds, all players take 50% of their maximum health as Oblivion damage over 5 seconds. At the same time, all healing taken is nullified. Ensure the party is fully healed before this attack lands.

abilities.name: Cowardice Purification
abilities.description: This ability will instantly kill any player that tries to exit the arena when they touch the barriers of light blocking the two exits.

notes: Iratan the Lightbringer is another of this type of Daedra called a "Blessed Sentinel", though he has two arms instead of four, and is smaller.
They are mentioned in a Loremaster's Archive, in which Lyranth states that they are "of little concern to the Kyn."
Though the official name of the type of Daedra is unknown, Loremaster Leamon Tuttle gave them the nickname "Meridimincers" in jest.
They are comparable in appearance to Mournful Aegises and Air Atronachs; its internal mesh name is "TombGuardian_B_MornAeg".
"Symphony of Blades" is the name of one of the Mournful Aegis' attacks.

summary: This article is about the boss in Depths of Malatar. For the boss in the Infinite Archive, see Symphony of Blades (Infinite Archive). For the item set, see Symphony of Blades (set). The Symphony of Blades is the final boss of the Depths of Malatar. It is King Narilmor transformed into an avatar of Meridia's power, in the image of an Auroran suit of armor with four arms wielding blades. In Veteran�HEALTH_VETERAN� mode, burning the Dictates of the Lady of Light will trigger hard mode, where it will now summon colored dark orbs. During the fight, it can summon the four colors of Aurorans to aid itself, which will converge from each corner of the room to join it in the center and empower it. It will also summon the Auroran Phalanx, a formation of Aurorans that march with Meridia's Light at their side and will empower the Symphony of Blades if they cross paths. After reaching around 10% of its health, the Symphony of Blades will transport you to the Colored Rooms, healing itself back up to 25% of its newly increased maximum health. It can also summon the Auroran Phalanx in the realm, spread up into various groups marching in different paths with three Aurorans in each group.
